panels.title: Steps today
panels.description: Garmin Connect’s total for the current local day.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("totalSteps") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Latest heart rate
panels.description: Most recent recorded heart-rate reading within 24 hours.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("HeartRate") FROM "HeartRateIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "HeartRate" > 0

panels.title: Last watch upload
panels.description: Time since the latest watch upload reported by Garmin Connect.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("Device_Name") FROM "DeviceSync" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Heart-rate sample age
panels.description: Time since the latest actual heart-rate sample. A watch upload may contain different data.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("HeartRate") FROM "HeartRateIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "HeartRate" > 0

panels.title: Step sample age
panels.description: Time since the last recorded 15-minute step sample, including zero-step samples.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("StepsCount") FROM "StepsIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Resting heart rate today
panels.description: Daily resting heart rate reported by Garmin.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("restingHeartRate") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter AND "restingHeartRate" > 0

panels.title: Last recorded sleep
panels.description: Age of the newest stored sleep session in the last 60 days. Click the value to open the session and its sensor graphs.

links.title: Open the latest recorded sleep session

targets.query: SELECT LAST("sleepTimeSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0

panels.title: Latest Body Battery
panels.description: Latest Body Battery reading in the last 24 hours.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("BodyBatteryLevel") FROM "BodyBatteryIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Heart rate
panels.description: Five-minute averages from recorded readings over the last 24 hours.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("HeartRate") FROM "HeartRateIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "HeartRate" > 0 GROUP BY time(5m) fill(null)

panels.title: Steps by 15-minute interval
panels.description: Steps recorded in each 15-minute interval over the last 24 hours.

targets.query: SELECT SUM("StepsCount") FROM "StepsIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(15m) fill(null)

panels.title: Stress
panels.description: Average of recorded Garmin stress scores per five minutes. Unavailable sensor intervals appear as gaps.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("stressLevel") FROM "StressIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "stressLevel" >= 0 GROUP BY time(5m) fill(null)

panels.title: Body Battery
panels.description: Average of recorded Body Battery scores per five minutes.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("BodyBatteryLevel") FROM "BodyBatteryIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m) fill(null)

panels.title: Breathing rate
panels.description: Five-minute averages from recorded breathing samples.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("BreathingRate") FROM "BreathingRateIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "BreathingRate" > 0 GROUP BY time(5m) fill(null)

panels.title: Recorded steps today
panels.description: Cumulative steps from recorded intervals since local midnight. The Garmin summary can include more data.

targets.query: SELECT CUMULATIVE_SUM(SUM("StepsCount")) FROM "StepsIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(15m) fill(null)

panels.title: Heart-rate distribution
panels.description: Distribution of positive heart-rate readings over the past 24 hours.

targets.query: SELECT "HeartRate" FROM "HeartRateIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "HeartRate" > 0

panels.title: Steps per hour
panels.description: Steps recorded in each hour over the past 24 hours.

targets.query: SELECT SUM("StepsCount") FROM "StepsIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1h) fill(null)

panels.title: Recorded steps by day
panels.description: Sum of recorded step intervals per local day. A partial day can differ from Garmin’s daily total.

targets.query: SELECT SUM("StepsCount") FROM "StepsIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Daily distance
panels.description: Daily distance reported in Garmin Connect.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("totalDistanceMeters") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Daily calories
panels.description: Active and basal calories from Garmin’s daily summaries.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("activeKilocalories") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("bmrKilocalories") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Daily intensity minutes
panels.description: Vigorous and moderate minutes from each recorded daily summary.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("moderateIntensityMinutes") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("vigorousIntensityMinutes") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Floors climbed and descended
panels.description: Daily counts of floors climbed and descended.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("floorsAscended") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("floorsDescended") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Daily movement and rest
panels.description: Active and sedentary time recorded in Garmin’s daily summaries.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("activeSeconds") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("sedentarySeconds") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Heart rate, stress and Body Battery
Daily heart-rate range
panels.description: Minimum, average, and maximum of the heart-rate samples collected each day.

targets.query: SELECT MIN("HeartRate") FROM "HeartRateIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "HeartRate" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT MEAN("HeartRate") FROM "HeartRateIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "HeartRate" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT MAX("HeartRate") FROM "HeartRateIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "HeartRate" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Resting heart rate by day
panels.description: Resting heart rate reported in the daily summary.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("restingHeartRate") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter AND "restingHeartRate" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Average recorded stress by day
panels.description: Average of available Garmin stress samples per day.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("stressLevel") FROM "StressIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "stressLevel" >= 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Daily stress by level
panels.description: Time Garmin classified as resting, low, medium or high stress.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("restStressDuration") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("lowStressDuration") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("mediumStressDuration") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("highStressDuration") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Daily Body Battery range
panels.description: Body Battery at waking and its daily high and low.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("bodyBatteryAtWakeTime") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter AND "bodyBatteryAtWakeTime" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("bodyBatteryHighestValue") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter AND "bodyBatteryHighestValue" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("bodyBatteryLowestValue") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter AND "bodyBatteryLowestValue" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Daily Body Battery charge and drain
panels.description: Garmin’s daily Body Battery gains and losses, shown as magnitudes.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("bodyBatteryChargedValue") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("bodyBatteryDrainedValue") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Daily oxygen saturation
panels.description: Average and lowest SpO₂ in the Garmin daily summary.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("averageSpo2") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter AND "averageSpo2" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("lowestSpo2") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter AND "lowestSpo2" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Daily breathing rate
panels.description: Average breathing rate from positive intraday samples.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("BreathingRate") FROM "BreathingRateIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "BreathingRate" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Last sleep duration
panels.description: Duration of the latest recorded sleep session in the last 60 days.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("sleepTimeSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0

panels.title: Last sleep stage breakdown
panels.description: Stage durations from the newest recorded sleep session in the last 60 days.

targets.query: SELECT "deepSleepSeconds", "lightSleepSeconds", "remSleepSeconds", "awakeSleepSeconds" FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Average sleep stage breakdown
panels.description: Mean durations by stage across recorded sleep sessions in the selected range.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("deepSleepSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0
SELECT MEAN("lightSleepSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0
SELECT MEAN("remSleepSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0
SELECT MEAN("awakeSleepSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0

panels.title: Sleep duration
panels.description: Total sleep time for nights with a recorded sleep summary.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("sleepTimeSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Sleep score
panels.description: Garmin sleep score for each recorded sleep summary.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("sleepScore") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "sleepScore" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Sleep stages
panels.description: Time spent in deep, light, REM, and awake stages for each recorded night.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("deepSleepSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("lightSleepSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("remSleepSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("awakeSleepSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Overnight HRV
panels.description: The nightly HRV average recorded in Garmin’s sleep summary.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("avgOvernightHrv") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "avgOvernightHrv" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Sleep breathing rate
panels.description: Average breathing rate from each recorded sleep summary.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("averageRespirationValue") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "averageRespirationValue" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Body Battery change during sleep
panels.description: Garmin’s recorded overnight Body Battery change.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("bodyBatteryChange") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Average overnight SpO₂
panels.description: Nightly average only on nights when Garmin records an SpO₂ measurement.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("averageSpO2Value") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "averageSpO2Value" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Sleep interruptions
panels.description: Awakenings and restless moments as reported by Garmin.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("awakeCount") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("restlessMomentsCount") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Overnight skin temperature deviation
panels.description: Garmin’s average overnight change from personal baseline in degrees Celsius.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("avgSkinTempDeviationC") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Average sleep stress
panels.description: Garmin’s average overnight stress score by date.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("avgSleepStress") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "avgSleepStress" >= 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Overnight oxygen saturation range
panels.description: Lowest and highest overnight SpO₂ reported for each night.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("lowestSpO2Value") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "lowestSpO2Value" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("highestSpO2Value") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "highestSpO2Value" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Overnight breathing rate range
panels.description: Lowest and highest breathing rates reported for each night.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("lowestRespirationValue") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "lowestRespirationValue" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
SELECT LAST("highestRespirationValue") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "highestRespirationValue" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Sleep stage timeline
panels.description: Deep, light, REM and awake intervals use the watch’s recorded start and duration. Zoom with the Last recorded sleep card for a session view.

targets.query: SELECT "SleepStageLevel" AS "Stage", "SleepStageSeconds" * 1000 AS "DurationMs" FROM "SleepIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "SleepStageSeconds" > 0 AND "SleepStageLevel" >= 0 AND "SleepStageLevel" <= 3

panels.title: Heart rate during sleep
panels.description: Averages of recorded sleep heart rate.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("heartRate") FROM "SleepIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "heartRate" > 0 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: HRV during sleep
panels.description: Averages of recorded overnight heart-rate variability.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("hrvValue") FROM "HRV_Intraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "hrvValue" > 0 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Breathing during sleep
panels.description: Averages of breathing samples recorded during sleep.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("respirationValue") FROM "SleepIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "respirationValue" > 0 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Oxygen saturation during sleep
panels.description: Averages of recorded overnight SpO₂ readings.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("spo2Reading") FROM "SleepIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "spo2Reading" > 0 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Movement during sleep
panels.description: Garmin’s recorded sleep movement levels, averaged in the chart interval.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("SleepMovementActivityLevel") FROM "SleepIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "SleepMovementActivityLevel" >= 0 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Body Battery during sleep
panels.description: Averages of recorded Body Battery during sleep.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("bodyBattery") FROM "SleepIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "bodyBattery" > 0 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Stress during sleep
panels.description: Averages of recorded overnight stress scores.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("stressValue") FROM "SleepIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "stressValue" >= 0 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Heart-rate samples by day
panels.description: Count of recorded readings per day. This shows coverage across the selected dates.

targets.query: SELECT COUNT("HeartRate") FROM "HeartRateIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter AND "HeartRate" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Step samples by day
panels.description: Count of recorded step intervals, including intervals with zero steps.

targets.query: SELECT COUNT("StepsCount") FROM "StepsIntraday" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')

panels.title: Watch uploads by day
panels.description: Count of upload timestamps recorded by the Garmin fetcher.

targets.query: SELECT COUNT("Device_Name") FROM "DeviceSync" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) tz('$TimeZone')
